name: Sprocket
text:
Do it: Auto-apply whitespace-only patches to third-party dependencies using Pret.

It cuts noise in PRs by removing trailing spaces and empty lines without touching logic. The trade-off is trusting Pret’s diff engine to avoid false positives—we accept that risk because the changes are trivial and reversible.

name: Gauge
text: Risk: Auto-applying whitespace patches to third-party deps risks breaking tooling that depends on exact formatting—like Pret’s own dry-run misreading indentation. Better alternative: Run Pret in CI as a linter, flag issues, let humans approve safe changes. Settle it: Prove no breakage by running Pret on a sample of deps, then show zero regressions in CI before automating.
